讚美之泉
詞、曲：何俊傑

lines.a: 時時稱頌祢 向祢來歌唱
lines.b: Lord, we sing Your praise, time and time again

lines.a: 因祢是拯救我們偉大的神
lines.b: For You've redeemed us, You're our saving grace

lines.a: 我們尊崇祢 稱頌祢聖名
lines.b: Lord, we honor You, lift Your holy name

lines.a: 口唱心和地 大聲地讚美祢
lines.b: With a joyful noise, we praise You night and day

lines.a: 不停讚美祢 大聲讚美祢
lines.b: Lift my praise to You, shout my praise to You

lines.a: 唯有祢配得榮耀 尊貴 權柄
lines.b: You alone deserve all glory, power and praise

lines.a: 天是屬於祢 地也屬於祢
lines.b: The heavens and the earth all belong to You

lines.a: 一切所造之物 齊來讚美祢
lines.b: All creation joins to praise and worship You

lines.a: 我讚美讚美 不停讚美
lines.b: I praise You, praise You, won't stop praising

lines.a: 跳舞跳舞 不停跳舞
高舉雙手 大聲讚美祢
lines.b: Lift my hands and give You all my praise

lines.a: 我讚美讚美 不停讚美
lines.b: I praise You, praise You, won't stop praising

lines.b: Lift my hands and give You all my praise
